title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to get current Profile (Role) info (Profile ID, Display Name, Source, Role Center ID, etc.) via AL
summary: This post demonstrates how to retrieve current user profile information including Profile ID, Display Name, Role Center ID, and Description using codeunit 9170 'Conf./Personalization Mgt.' in AL code, which provides more details than methods that only return the profile ID alone.
key_points: Use codeunit 9170 'Conf./Personalization Mgt.' with its GetCurrentProfile procedure to access comprehensive profile data
This method returns the complete 'All Profile' record with multiple properties like Profile ID, Role Center ID, and Description
The approach goes beyond simpler methods that can only retrieve the profile ID without additional profile attributes
Practical implementation shown through a page extension example on Customer List page

quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the specific system codeunit developers should use to access comprehensive profile data
Shows the exact method signature that retrieves the full profile record with all available properties
